item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"The stub LM returns bare JSON (`{\"answer\": \"Paris\"}`), and the strict `ChatAdapter` path raises `AdapterParseError`, demonstrating that marker-delimited fields are the normal chat parse format and raw JSON is not accepted there."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"It shows the default `ChatAdapter()` permissive retry behavior and the strict opt-out via `use_json_adapter_fallback=False`, matching the `ChatAdapter.__call__` fallback split the question asked about."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"The program runs the raw-JSON completion through default `dspy.ChatAdapter()`, prints the permissive result, and asserts the exact parsed output `[{\"answer\": \"Paris\"}]`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The same stub completion is run through `dspy.ChatAdapter(use_json_adapter_fallback=False)`, and the code asserts failure by raising `AdapterParseError` instead of silently falling back."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
